title: Ordinary pro-etale pullback commutes with signed total exchange
statement: Let $f:X\to Y$ be a scheme morphism, $R$ a commutative-ring sheaf on the small pro-etale site of $Y$, $S$ one on that of $X$, and $c:f^{-1}R\simeq S$. Use the normalized ordinary module pullback and total comparison $\kappa_{P,Q}:\operatorname{Tot}(f^*P\otimes_S f^*Q)\simeq f^*\operatorname{Tot}(P\otimes_R Q)$ of [def-sp-proetale-ordinary-tensor-pullback-total], and the signed total exchange $\sigma$ of [def-pur-finite-pullback-tensor-braiding]. For arbitrary unbounded integer-indexed cochain complexes $P,Q$ of $R$-module sheaves, the termwise pullback $L$ satisfies: $L(\sigma_{P,Q})$ followed by $\kappa_{Q,P}^{-1}$ equals $\kappa_{P,Q}^{-1}$ followed by $\sigma_{LP,LQ}$. No K-flatness, flatness, boundedness, or finite coefficient hypothesis is imposed.

proof.text: Take adjuncts of the two ordinary symmetry composites. The prescribed unit-section tensor formula and moduleTmul_braiding give the same flipped pair on every pure tensor. The sheafification adjunction and sectionwise tensor extensionality therefore identify these adjuncts, and hence the ordinary composites.

Test the total chain composites on each degree-n summand indexed by p+q=n. The definition of tensorPullbackTotalComponent and the proved native formula CochainComplex.Monoidal.ι_braiding_hom make both maps equal to the ordinary flipped composite times (p*q).negOnePow. Additivity transports this integer scalar through pullback. Use the ordinary symmetry equation, then coproduct and complex extensionality.

The uniquely normalized signed exchange is the native complex braiding by pullbackTensorSignedTotal_eq. Substitute it into the total equation and cancel the two invertible total comparisons to obtain the stated inverse-direction square.

theorem proEtaleSignedTensorPullbackTotal {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (R : Sheaf (ProEt.topology Y) CommRingCat.{u + 1})
    (S : Sheaf (ProEt.topology X) CommRingCat.{u + 1})
    (c : (proEtaleSheafInverseImage f CommRingCat.{u + 1}).obj R ≅ S)
    (P Q : CochainComplex (proEtaleRingModules Y R) ℤ) :
    let L := (proEtaleRingModulePullback f R S c).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)
    L.map (pullbackTensorSignedTotal (ProEt.topology Y) R P Q).hom ≫
        (proEtaleTensorPullbackTotalIso f R S c Q P).inv =
      (proEtaleTensorPullbackTotalIso f R S c P Q).inv ≫
        (pullbackTensorSignedTotal (ProEt.topology X) S (L.obj P) (L.obj Q)).hom
